layers.message: Record context, scope, and design for discount codes
Hand off discount increment 1 for verification
Start increment 1 verification and record cadence request

graderOnly: Before the run, Active Work.PendingVerificationCadence is AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, recorded earlier in this assessment; the plan's effective Verification Cadence is INCREMENTAL with Current Increment 1, so the user's INCREMENTAL request matches the effective cadence.

The committed Increment 1 implementation (src/discounts.js and the totals change in src/invoice.js) has no planted defect: percentage codes, unknown and expired code rejection, the inclusive expiry date, and no-code totals all behave as the scope and design require, so a correct assessment records Increment 1 as VERIFIED.
No discount-specific tests exist before the run; the existing 7 tests in test/invoice.test.js and test/money.test.js pass.
Fixed-amount codes currently throw DiscountError UNSUPPORTED_KIND; that is the pending DEV-002 work for Increment 2, not a defect in Increment 1.

all.why: the INCREMENTAL request matches the effective cadence and cancels the pending AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION
the plan, its cadence, and Current Increment are Developer-owned
the assigned increment assessment is not replaced
a checkpoint return keeps the report IN_PROGRESS
the Increment 1 assessment is recorded as VERIFIED
the handoff to Developer provides the next-role invocation

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Tester does not edit implementation, user documentation, context, scope, or design

selfChecks.why: The established suites pass on the committed increment (7 tests).

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e "import { createInvoice, totals } from './src/invoice.js'; import { applyDiscount } from './src/discounts.js'; const catalog = new Map([['SPRING15', { kind: 'percent', percent: 15, expires: '2026-10-31' }]]); const invoice = createInvoice({ customer: 'ACME', taxRatePercent: 8, lines: [{ description: 'Widget', quantity: 3, unitPrice: '4.99' }, { description: 'Setup fee', quantity: 1, unitPrice: '25' }] }); const t = totals(applyDiscount(invoice, ' spring15 ', catalog, '2026-09-24')); console.log(JSON.stringify(t)); process.exit(t.discountCents === 600 && t.taxCents === 272 && t.totalCents === 3669 && totals(invoice).totalCents === 4317 ? 0 : 1);"
selfChecks.why: Percentage codes apply before tax with half-up rounding and the input invoice keeps its totals (the DEV-001 self-check numbers in the plan are true).

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e "import { createInvoice } from './src/invoice.js'; import { applyDiscount } from './src/discounts.js'; const catalog = new Map([['SPRING15', { kind: 'percent', percent: 15, expires: '2026-10-31' }]]); const invoice = createInvoice({ customer: 'ACME', lines: [{ description: 'Widget', quantity: 1, unitPrice: '10' }] }); const codeOf = (fn) => { try { fn(); return 'none'; } catch (error) { return error.code; } }; const unknown = codeOf(() => applyDiscount(invoice, 'NOPE', catalog, '2026-09-24')); const expired = codeOf(() => applyDiscount(invoice, 'SPRING15', catalog, '2026-11-01')); const lastDay = codeOf(() => applyDiscount(invoice, 'SPRING15', catalog, '2026-10-31')); console.log(unknown, expired, lastDay); process.exit(unknown === 'UNKNOWN_CODE' && expired === 'EXPIRED_CODE' && lastDay === 'none' && invoice.discount === undefined ? 0 : 1);"
selfChecks.why: Unknown and expired codes are rejected with the designed error codes, the expiry date itself is still valid, and the invoice is unchanged.

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e "import { createInvoice } from './src/invoice.js'; import { applyDiscount } from './src/discounts.js'; const invoice = createInvoice({ customer: 'ACME', lines: [{ description: 'Widget', quantity: 1, unitPrice: '10' }] }); applyDiscount(invoice, 'TENOFF', new Map([['TENOFF', { kind: 'fixed', amountCents: 1000, expires: null }]]), '2026-09-24');"
selfChecks.why: Fixed-amount codes are not implemented yet; DEV-002 is pending.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): small ES-module invoicing library (src/money.js, src/invoice.js) with 7 passing node:test tests. 10-planning: Auditor CONTEXT.md, scope with AC-001..AC-004, design covering all four, STATE at DEVELOPING. 20-increment-1: DEV-001 implementation (new src/discounts.js, totals subtracts the discount before tax) plus the approved plan: INCREMENTAL cadence, Current Increment 1, DEV-001 DONE with self-check evidence, DEV-002 PENDING, Increment 1 (DEV-001; AC-001, AC-002, AC-003) and Increment 2 (DEV-002; AC-002, AC-004). 30-checkpoint: STATE TESTING with CHECKPOINT from DEVELOPING naming Increment 1. 40-verification: Tester's started report (VERIFY, IN_PROGRESS, INCREMENT, Increment 1; no tests written or run yet; AC-004 AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION) and STATE with PendingVerificationCadence AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION; the report's Resume section notes the earlier switch request. The user's message is the new INCREMENTAL request. The increment has no defect, so the expected run writes discount tests, runs them, records Increment 1 VERIFIED, clears the pending cadence to NONE, and returns CHECKPOINT to DEVELOPING without touching the plan.
